title: xDrip deleted my database
symptom: xDrip deleted the user's database, happening multiple times. The user noticed a daily job ran at the time of deletion, but backup and delete older settings were unmarked. The user reinstalled and the problem recurred.
evidence_quote: I reinstalled everything and tonight the database has been erased. This is something never happened before, I've been using xdrip+ for years. This is the first time I use it with Libre 2
